messages:
jess: FYI change window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Tight freeze 01:50-04:30. Target: v2.0.0-quant (production quantization + kernel tweak).

lee: Noted. Is this deploying to Dedicated or Hosted? Any capacity pinning needed?

jess: Dedicated GPUs pool. We'll reserve pool-id=dedicated-eu-3 for the rollout. Pinning Docker image to sha256:bb9f... to avoid accidental rebuilds.

pm-ana: Release notes draft: https://go.redwood/release/v2.0.0-quant. Major: int8 quant flag, new matmul kernel, batcher tweak. Minor: telemetry additions.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan:
  env=prod
  version=v2.0.0-quant
  mode=staged
  stage_steps=[5%, 20%, 50%, 100%]
  start=3799997777

infra-eng: Quick callout: model-serving will enable flag "quantize_int8=true". If OOMs hit, fallback to "quantize_int8=false" is supported via runtime toggle.

sre-oncall: SLO watch: 5xx > 0.4% for 3m OR p99>1.2s for 3m -> page. Smoke tests in kube staging passing. I have alert hooks and Kibana dashboard ready.

lee: Can we set a safety hold at 20% until we validate tail latency? Suggest manual proceed after 20m observe.

deploy-bot: Canary advancing: 5% -> 20%. Current step=20%. Safety-hold at 20% enabled (manual release required after observe=20m).

jess: Copy. Observing now. Please run tail-latency check every 5m.

sre-oncall: First 5m check: p99 ~ 1.05s, 5xx=0.05%. OK. Running extended tail tests.

pm-ana: FYI we've pinned feature-flag ff_quant_experiment to org=platform only for this rollout. No customer-facing toggle.

infra-eng: Getting an internal alert: OOMs on worker-3 in eu-west1 (container restart count increased). Possibly kernel memory regression.

sre-oncall: Noted, isolating traces. If restarts continue -> trigger rollback.

lee: Do we have an auto-fallback rule? deploy-bot, add fallback to v1.9.8 with immediate rollback if OOMs>0 for 2m on >3 pods.

deploy-bot: Auto-fallback rule applied:
  fallback_version=v1.9.8
  trigger=(oom_count>3 across pods in 2m) OR (p99>1.2s for 3m)
  action=rollback-to-fallback

jess: Also open a freeze-exemption for infra if they need to push a hotfix during freeze. Use #hotfix-exempt and tag @eng-lead.

infra-eng: I'm scaling down batch_size from 128 -> 64 on worker-3 to reduce memory. Applying via runtime toggle now.

sre-oncall: After toggle, restart rate normalizing. p99 dropping to 0.9s. No 5xx surge.

lee: Good. Recommend proceeding to 50% after a short soak (10m). I approve.

deploy-bot: Canary advancing to 50% (per manual approve by lee).

pm-ana: Publishing release note update: pinned to v1.9.8 fallback, documented rollback procedure, noted batch_size change. Sharing to #release-notes post-deploy.

jess: Preflight checklist complete. Post-deploy tasks: notify customers in next status bulletin, run nightly perf regression suite, schedule RCA if we see regressions.

infra-eng: Adding quick rollback snippet to runbook:```
# rollback via deploy CLI
/deploy rollback --env prod --to v1.9.8 --confirm --reason "quant-int8-ooms"

# runtime toggle to disable quantization
/runtoggle set quantize_int8=false --env prod --target pool=dedicated-eu-3
```

sre-oncall: Final check: 50% steady for 12m, p99=0.95s, 5xx=0.02%. Green to continue to 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed: status=success, final_version=v2.0.0-quant, completed_at=3799997890

jess: :tada: Great job. Leaving the freeze at 04:30 UTC. We'll keep telemetry flagged for 24h. Postmortem only if regression appears.

pm-ana: I'll circulate the release summary and pin the changelog in the docs. Thanks everyone!
